concerns.text: FR-001 (entropy extraction via AST‑based clustering) has no dedicated verification task; the task list only contains a stub (T005) but no task that produces or validates `entropy_results.csv` or confirms the clustering methodology.

FR-007 (edge‑case handling) is not covered by any task – there is no task that logs excluded/undefined entropy samples, verifies censored‑data handling, or tests the hierarchical mixed‑effects handling of low‑sample strata.

SC-005 (reporting total runtime and resource usage) lacks an explicit task; while T704 runs a verification suite, no task records or publishes the overall execution time, GPU memory consumption, or FLOPs budget for the full pipeline.
